newsitem.title: USA: NYC seeks new partner to run two hospitals - paper.
newsitem.headline: NYC seeks new partner to run two hospitals - paper.

text.p: New York City is looking for a new partner for its biggest medical-care contract, a $100 million deal to run the Queens and Elmhurst Hospital Centers, the New York Times said on Thursday.
The city since October has been negotiating with Mount Sinai Medical Center, which has supplied doctors for Queens and Elmhurst.

But a deal fell through because Mount Sinai was reluctant to give New York City more control over running the hospital and to link productivity and quality of care to what the center would be paid, the paper said.
Mount Sinai said it would carefully review the city's request for a new partner and might consider submitting a bid.
